extracted.subtask_description: A set of transparency indicators developed by The Trust Project for news organizations to display on articles to signal journalistic quality and production practices. Intended to help audiences identify high-quality journalism and reduce the spread of misinformation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of The Trust Project's initial 'Trust Indicators' to increase transparency in journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: News organizations will display this indicator on their own articles as part of a set intended to amplify high-quality journalism and help users avoid lower-quality sources that may contain misinformation or disinformation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author/ Reporter Expertise
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of The Trust Project's initial 'Trust Indicators' focusing on the expertise of the author or reporter.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Displayed by news organizations on articles to signal reporter credentials or expertise; part of the project's effort to increase transparency and trust in journalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Type of Work
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of The Trust Project's initial 'Trust Indicators' identifying the kind of content (e.g., news report, analysis, opinion).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to clarify for readers what type of journalistic piece they are viewing; implemented by news organizations as an on-article indicator to improve transparency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citations and References
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of The Trust Project's initial 'Trust Indicators' concerning the presence of citations and references in a piece.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals sourcing and allows readers to verify information; part of the indicator set that news organizations can display to demonstrate rigorous sourcing practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methods
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of The Trust Project's initial 'Trust Indicators' referring to the methods used to gather and verify information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Meant to inform readers about how reporting was conducted (e.g., verification steps); included in the indicators to increase transparency about journalistic processes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Locally Sourced
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of The Trust Project's initial 'Trust Indicators' denoting local sourcing of information or reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to indicate when reporting relies on local sources and reporting capacity, helping audiences assess proximity and relevance of coverage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Diverse Voices
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of The Trust Project's initial 'Trust Indicators' addressing inclusion of diverse perspectives in coverage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Intended to show whether a piece consulted or included a range of voices; part of the transparency indicators displayed by news organizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Actionable Feedback
rubrics_metrics.description: Listed as one of The Trust Project's initial 'Trust Indicators' concerning mechanisms for audience feedback and corrections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Signals whether readers can provide feedback or see corrections and updates; aimed at increasing accountability and trust in journalism.
